description: This file defines the OrganizationsConferencingService class, which manages conferencing app integrations, including connecting, disconnecting, and setting default conferencing apps for teams within a NestJS application.

classes.name: OrganizationsConferencingService
classes.description: Service class for managing team conferencing applications, including connecting, disconnecting, and setting default apps.

methods.name: connectTeamNonOauthApps
methods.description: Connects a non-OAuth conferencing app (e.g., Google Meet) to a team.

methods.name: connectTeamOauthApps
methods.description: Handles OAuth app connection process for a team.

methods.name: getConferencingApps
methods.description: Retrieves conferencing apps connected to a team.

methods.name: getDefaultConferencingApp
methods.description: Fetches the default conferencing app for a team.

methods.name: checkAppIsValidAndConnected
methods.description: Validates if an app is recognized and connected for a team.

methods.name: disconnectConferencingApp
methods.description: Disconnects a conferencing app from a team.

methods.name: setDefaultConferencingApp
methods.description: Sets a specified app as the default conferencing app for a team.
